PostToolUse.description: Coder progress marker — append durable activity log for PM silent-termination recovery

Undurable-work gate — after an edit inside an agent worktree that holds NO commit of its own, demand commit+push once uncommitted work reaches 120 lines. Measures the BLAST RADIUS of a watchdog cut, not silence: a workspace with no commit of its own is the one the harness removes as unchanged, so a cut there loses the stretch outright instead of costing a re-read (2026-10-20: five agents cut in one day, one losing a 231-line single-call compose). PostToolUse so nothing is reverted; the first commit silences it for the session. Test: scripts/devops/tests/test-post-edit-write-undurable-work.sh

Heartbeat ledger — one line per completed tool call of an agent worktree into .claude/agent-heartbeat.log, so the silence the 600 s watchdog kills on is a measured number instead of an inference. post:edit-write:coder-progress cannot answer this: it only sees edits, and on 2026-10-20 five agents were cut in one day while that log recorded two lines. Observation only, exit 0 always (advisory). Consumer: scripts/devops/check-stream-silence.sh

PreToolUse.description: RTK output filter (token-economy) — rewrites a Bash command to `rtk <cmd>` so its output is compacted before it reaches the model. Fail-open: no `rtk` binary on PATH = no-op. Never refuses. Binary pinned and checksum-verified by scripts/devops/install-rtk.sh. One command unfiltered: `rtk bypass <cmd>`. Rationale: docs/architecture/rules-rationale/token-economy.md
Safety gate — block catastrophic Bash patterns (rm -rf /, force push to main, DROP DATABASE crm_db)

Coder push gate — require an `ac_verified:` LINE in the last commit before push on EVERY branch except main/master, architect/* and legal/*. Inverted 2026-09-01: the old feature|fix|infra|test allowlist silently missed feat/ across 15 merged PRs (and docs/, ci/, perf/, worktree-agent-*), because an allowlist fails by saying nothing. Honest escapes when a branch has nothing to verify: a `wip:` subject, or `ac_verified: n/a (<why>)`. Exemption costs are written in the hook header; test: scripts/devops/tests/test-pre-bash-coder-push-gate.sh
Prettier push gate — block git push when PR-changed files are not prettier-formatted (local mirror of CI check-formatting; worktree-safe, fail-loud)

Mutation gate push gate — run mutation-gate.mjs --changed on git push, local mirror of CI's mutation gate; BLOCK only on a real finding (survivor / reasonless suppression), SKIP (visible banner) whenever it could not run at all

Devserver TTL gate — block raw dev-server boots (nest/vite/pnpm dev/dist-main) inside agent worktrees and claude scratchpads without scripts/devops/dev-ttl.sh wrapper (zombie prevention, 2026-07-24 incident)

Live-DB guard — block dev-server boots (nest/vite/pnpm dev/dist-main) inside agent worktrees and claude scratchpads unless DATABASE_URL and port are explicitly set inline to non-live values (live-db-corruption prevention, 2026-08-05 incident PR #485)

Cross-agent blast gate — from an agent workspace, block broadcast process kills (pkill/killall), removing/pruning another agent's worktree, and mutating another agent's tree or the shared checkout (2026-08-17 incidents PR #547 / #544 / #551). Reads and kill-by-PID stay allowed.

Unbounded-wait gate — block a while/until wait loop with no bound (no `timeout N bash -c`, no $SECONDS / date +%s deadline, no iteration counter), any loop waiting on tasks/<id>.status|.exit (the harness never writes them), and a bare `cat` reading an agent's stdin. Decided on command position, not substring. Incidents 2026-09-21 (cat, 25h), 09-24 (Stryker grep loop, ~3h), 09-25 (.status/.exit loops, 11.5h). Test: scripts/devops/tests/test-pre-bash-unbounded-wait.sh

Swallowed-failure advisory — NEVER refuses, prints one note. Fires when a named-object read (git show/cat-file/log/diff, cat, head, tail, jq) discards stderr and feeds a counter (grep -c/-q, wc -l/-w/-c): a 0 there means "nothing matched" OR "nothing was read", indistinguishable at the counter, which produced two consecutive wrong verifications on 2026-10-21. Also reports an unbraced $VAR: in a revspec (the harness shell is zsh, which eats the colon as a modifier; quoting does not help, braces do). Advisory because the readiness-probe population is legitimate and a false refusal costs the credibility of the whole hook layer, while a missed note costs one recoverable wrong answer. Rule: .claude/rules/common/verification-integrity.md Test: scripts/devops/tests/test-pre-bash-swallowed-failure.sh

Dispatch isolation gate — block dispatching a WRITING subagent (coder/autotest/devops/ui-ux-designer/manual-qa/legal/pm/architect) without isolation=worktree or an explicit cwd, and block handing a shared absolute work dir in the prompt. Read-only agents pass untouched (PR #497 / #493).
Zone-of-write gate — block apps/** and packages/** edits from non-Coder sessions
Compact suggestion — surface /compact reminder every 50 Edit/Write invocations (never blocks)
